title: 1990 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: One proposal for new postage rates for a letter was \(30\)¢ for the first ounce and \(22\)¢ for each additional ounce (or fraction of an ounce). The postage for a letter weighing \(4.5\) ounces was

solutions.text:
The first ounce costs \(30\)¢. The remaining \(3.5\) ounces are charged as \(4\) additional ounces, since any fraction rounds up to a full ounce.

That is \(4 \cdot 22\)¢ \(= 88\)¢, so the total is \(30\)¢ \(+ 88\)¢ \(= 118\)¢ \(= \$1.18.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: The first ounce costs \(30\)¢; the remaining \(3.5\) ounces are billed as full additional ounces
A fraction of an ounce counts as a whole additional ounce, so \(3.5\) ounces beyond the first counts as \(4\)
